title: Lenovo Made a 990 g Laptop That Claims 27 Hours
description:
Lenovo's ThinkBook 14x weighs from 990 g, has a 120 Hz OLED screen, and claims up to 27 hours of battery — and it's going global. But there's a catch.

Spec or wreck? Tell us below.

Battery: 27.08 h = Lenovo's 1080p local video test at 150 nits (65 Wh); 16.42 h in MobileMark 30 at 250 nits. US price from $999, expected January 2027 (as reported 16 Nov 2026).
